name: font-ttf-geist
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.7.2"

package:
  name: font-ttf-geist
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # Upstream runs two tag lines in the same repository. Bare tags (1.7.0, 1.8.0) track the
  # font design version, while v-prefixed / changesets tags (v1.7.1, v1.7.2) track the npm
  # `geist` package and are the ones that currently carry the font zip. v1.7.2 (2026-06-01)
  # is the newest stable release and is what /releases/latest resolves to; the bare tag
  # 1.8.0 (2026-03-03) sorts higher but is three months older and ships older binaries.
  # See https://github.com/vercel/geist-font/issues/208 and conda-forge.yml for bot pinning.
  url: https://github.com/vercel/geist-font/releases/download/v${{ version }}/geist-font-v${{ version }}.zip
  sha256: 7fc800d2ac6b92844895196e5041aca55d814c15db70c44f79b3b83ab82b04e2

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  script:
    - mkdir -p $PREFIX/fonts
    - cp Geist/ttf/*.ttf $PREFIX/fonts/
    - cp Geist/variable/*.ttf $PREFIX/fonts/
    - cp GeistMono/ttf/*.ttf $PREFIX/fonts/
    - cp GeistMono/variable/*.ttf $PREFIX/fonts/

tests:
  # `strict` also asserts the negative: the archive's OTF, woff2, Geist Pixel and HTML
  # files must not end up in the package. `[[]` escapes the literal `[` of the variable
  # font filenames, which would otherwise be read as a glob character class.
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - fonts/Geist-Black.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-BlackItalic.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-Bold.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-BoldItalic.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-ExtraBold.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-ExtraBoldItalic.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-ExtraLight.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-ExtraLightItalic.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-Italic.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-Light.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-LightItalic.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-Medium.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-MediumItalic.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-Regular.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-SemiBold.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-SemiBoldItalic.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-Thin.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-ThinItalic.ttf
        - fonts/Geist-Italic[[]wght].ttf
        - fonts/Geist[[]wght].ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-Black.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-BlackItalic.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-Bold.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-BoldItalic.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-ExtraBold.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-ExtraBoldItalic.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-ExtraLight.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-ExtraLightItalic.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-Italic.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-Light.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-LightItalic.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-Medium.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-MediumItalic.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-Regular.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-SemiBold.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-SemiBoldItalic.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-Thin.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-ThinItalic.ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono-Italic[[]wght].ttf
        - fonts/GeistMono[[]wght].ttf
      strict: true

about:
  homepage: https://vercel.com/font
  summary: "The Geist and Geist Mono typefaces"
  description: |
    Geist is a typeface family designed by Vercel in collaboration with
    basement.studio. Geist (also called Geist Sans) is a neo-grotesque sans-serif
    drawn for clarity in developer-facing interfaces, and Geist Mono is its
    monospaced companion for code, terminals and tabular data.

    This package installs the static TTF weights (Thin through Black, each with a
    matching italic) and the variable TTFs for both families.
  license: OFL-1.1
  license_file: OFL.txt
  repository: https://github.com/vercel/geist-font

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - anjos
